mentions.name: Aaron Gordon
mentions.analysis: Aaron Gordon has a calf strain and is expected to be out for four weeks. Payton Watson is recommended as an add because he will likely play 27 to 31 minutes a night in Gordon's absence.

mentions.name: Jeremy Sochan
mentions.analysis: Jeremy Sochan has a fracture in his thumb and is having surgery, which will sideline him for six to eight weeks. Julian Champagnie is suggested as the priority add to cover for Sochan's absence.

mentions.name: Nick Richards
mentions.analysis: Nick Richards has a fractured rib cartilage and is expected to be out for at least two weeks, possibly a month. With Mark Williams expected back before Richards, it is advised to drop Richards.

mentions.name: Payton Watson
mentions.analysis: With Aaron Gordon out, Payton Watson is expected to play significant minutes and is recommended as an add. He is seen as a potential long-term value player.

mentions.name: Julian Champagnie
mentions.analysis: Julian Champagnie is recommended as a priority add due to injuries to Jeremy Sochan and the Spurs' favorable schedule. He is expected to have long-term value.

mentions.name: Goga Bitadze
mentions.analysis: Goga Bitadze started over Mo Wagner and played 26 minutes in his first game back. With Wendell Carter Jr. out, Bitadze is a recommended add if he continues to get significant minutes.

mentions.name: Obi Toppin
mentions.analysis: Obi Toppin played 24 minutes last game due to having to cover center minutes. He might have enough minutes to be a 12-team league guy if the situation persists.

mentions.name: Zach Edey
mentions.analysis: Zach Edey had a monster game against the Brooklyn Nets but has been inconsistent. His performance against Anthony Davis and LeBron James will be a key data point.

mentions.name: Amen Thompson
mentions.analysis: Amen Thompson's minutes could increase with Tari Eason and Dillon Brooks both questionable. He has been getting more minutes recently and is worth a speculative add.

mentions.name: Brandon Boston Jr.
mentions.analysis: Brandon Boston Jr. started and played big minutes in the last game. His role could expand if Jordan Hawkins and Zion Williamson remain out.

mentions.name: Ayo Dosunmu
mentions.analysis: With Zach LaVine out, Ayo Dosunmu's value rises significantly. He is a recommended add with the current schedule favoring the Bulls.

mentions.name: Naji Marshall
mentions.analysis: Naji Marshall played well last game and could see more minutes with PJ Washington out. He is worth monitoring for potential increased role.

mentions.name: Russell Westbrook
mentions.analysis: Russell Westbrook is a stream option with Jamal Murray out. He was excellent last game and could be used in the short term.

mentions.name: Gradey Dick
mentions.analysis: Gradey Dick has been performing well with high usage and shooting, but this is unsustainable. He is a sell-high candidate before Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley return.

mentions.name: Keon Ellis
mentions.analysis: Keon Ellis is a good stream option for steals, especially if Kevin Huerter remains out. He started last game and could continue to see minutes.
